name: Beginner Rod
description: Tier 1 rod. Cast range grows from 15 ft at Fishing 1 to 60 ft at Fishing 10. Base control 1.20.

name: Apprentice Rod
description: Tier 2 rod. Cast range grows from 60 ft at Fishing 20 to 90 ft at Fishing 30. Base control 1.55.

name: Pro Rod
description: Tier 3 rod. Cast range grows from 90 ft at Fishing 40 to 120 ft at Fishing 50. Base control 2.09.

name: Low Grade Fish Food
description: Grade 1 fish food used as bait. Attracts only low-grade fish (tiers 1-3). Consumes one per released cast.

name: Medium Grade Fish Food
description: Grade 2 fish food used as bait. Attracts only medium-grade fish (tiers 4-6). Consumes one per released cast.

name: High Grade Fish Food
description: Grade 3 fish food used as bait. Attracts only high-grade fish (tiers 7-10). Consumes one per released cast.
